text: Fifteen years after [stabbing his sister to death as a child|wrong|killing within the family], Michael Myers escapes a sanitarium and comes home to Haddonfield for Halloween in a [white mask stolen from a hardware store|images|dolls, masks and likenesses]. He shadows babysitter Laurie Strode through the day while [her friends laugh off her fears|rules|no one believes you], then moves from house to house along her street after dark. His psychiatrist, Dr. Loomis, prowls the roads looking for him, and little Tommy insists that [you cannot kill the boogeyman|rules|nothing can stop it].
